description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Riley Moss (ribs) is active for the Broncos on Thursday night against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Moss was initially questionable for the contest, but he will play and reinforce the Broncos secondary. He will try to step up in Pat Surtain's absence, but gets a tough assignment in JSN and company.
items.title: Riley Moss (ribs) active on Thursday night

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: George Holani is active for Seattle's Thursday Night Football game against the Broncos.
items.impact: Holani was able to get back from a rib injury after missing the past several weeks. He will split the backfield workload with Emanuel Wilson, but Wilson is the better fantasy option, with Holani being primarily a third down back with little upside.
items.title: George Holani active for Thursday Night Football

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Pat Surtain II (ankle) has been ruled out for the Broncos contest against the Seahawks on Thursday due to an ankle injury.
items.impact: Surtain will miss yet another game, but with the Bronco's having a mini bye week, hopefully he can return for Week 7. Denver will have to make it work without him.
items.title: Pat Surtain II (ankle) out for Thursday night against Seattle

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Tank Dell (knee) will not play in Sunday's matchup against the Jaguars.
items.impact: There was some thought that Dell would finally make his long-awaited return for the Texans on Sunday. Instead, even after practicing in full on Wednesday, he will remain behind as the team travels to London. Dell seems likely to play in Week 7 against the Giants.
items.title: Tank Dell (knee) will not return in Week 6

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: David Montgomery (groin) will not play against the Jaguars on Sunday.
items.impact: As expected, Montgomery will not play in Sunday's divisional matchup in London. The veteran back has not practiced this week due to a groin injury and will cede the lead RB role to Woody Marks.
items.title: David Montgomery (groin) out for Week 6

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Jalen Pitre (shoulder) will not play in Sunday's game against the Jaguars.
items.impact: Pitre will remain behind as the Texans travel to London to face the division-rival Jaguars. Kamari Ramsey is likely to see an uptick in snaps.
items.title: Jalen Pitre (shoulder) to miss Week 6

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Rico Dowdle (toe) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran running back was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday after being limited by a toe injury on Wednesday. He should be available to play in Week 6 and will likely be an involved RB2 for the Steelers behind Jaylen Warren moving forward.
items.title: Rico Dowdle (toe) upgraded to full participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Jalen Ramsey (wrist) returned to practice as a limited participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Ramsey has been playing through a wrist injury for a while, so it was no surprise to see him sidelined at Pittsburgh's first practice of the week on Wednesday. He made his return to practice on Thursday and should be good to go for Week 6, barring setbacks.
items.title: Jalen Ramsey (wrist) returns to practice Thursday

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: DeAndre Carter has signed to join the Lions' practice squad.
items.impact: Carter has yet to play this season after he was released by the Browns in late August. The veteran appeared in four games for the Browns last season, returning six punts and 11 kickoffs while playing solely on special teams.
items.title: DeAndre Carter signs with Lions

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: David Sills V (hamstring) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
items.impact: Sills recently had his 21-day practice window opened and has been a full participant at practice all week so far. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be a relevant fantasy option moving forward, however, even when he's back to full health.
items.title: David Sills V (hamstring) practices in full Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Tristan Wirfs (knee) logged another full practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Wirfs has been a full participant at practice all week so far, so it looks like he's going to be available to play in Week 6. His expected presence is great news for Tampa Bay's offense as they prepare for a tough matchup against the Steelers this week.
items.title: Tristan Wirfs (knee) logs full practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Sean Tucker (quad) was officially limited at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Tucker was able to return to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday after being sidelined by a quad injury on Wednesday. This is a good sign that he will play in Week 6, but we won't know his official status until after practice on Friday.
items.title: Sean Tucker (quad) officially limited Thursday

items.author: Nate Miller
items.desc: Rashee Rice (hamstring) did not practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Rice has missed practice each of the past two days due to a hamstring issue. Rice sustained the injury in Week 4, and his status for Sunday's game certainly seems in question. Jalen Royals stands to see an uptick in snaps if Rice sits.
items.title: Rashee Rice (hamstring) sits out Thursday's practice

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Tyjae Spears (knee) was downgraded to a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Spears was limited at Wednesday's practice due to a knee issue, but he was downgraded to a non-participant on Thursday. It's still unclear if this was simply a load management move on the part of the team or if this is a real issue for him, so fantasy managers should keep close tabs on his status heading into the weekend and expect more work for Tony Pollard if Spears is ruled out for Week 6.
items.title: Tyjae Spears (knee) downgraded to non-participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Tony Pollard (rest) returned to practice as a full participant on Thursday.
items.impact: Pollard was given the day off on Wednesday as a veteran rest day, and he was able to make his return to practice as a full participant on Thursday. He should be good to go for Week 6 and will be primed for more work than usual if Tyjae Spears (knee) is limited or sidelined against the Colts on Sunday.
items.title: Tony Pollard (rest) returns to practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Amani Hooker (concussion) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Hooker was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday after being limited on Wednesday, so it looks like he is very close to fully clearing the NFL's concussion protocols. He should be available to play in Week 6, which is good news for Tennessee's secondary ahead of a matchup against the Colts.
items.title: Amani Hooker (concussion) upgraded to full participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: David Martin-Robinson (hamstring) was limited for another practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Martin-Robinson's hamstring injury left him limited for another practice on Thursday. It seems likely that he will play through it in Week 6, but we won't know for sure until after practice on Friday.
items.title: David Martin-Robinson (hamstring) limited again Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Dylan Parham (knee) was a non-participant at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Parham wasn't able to practice again on Thursday, which comes as no surprise, as he is still dealing with his knee injury. He seems likely to be sidelined in Week 6, which is less than ideal for New York's offense ahead of a matchup against the Patriots' defense.
items.title: Dylan Parham (knee) a non-participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Kenyon Sadiq (concussion) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie is at risk of being sidelined on Sunday. He's still going through the NFL's concussion protocols and remained limited for another practice on Thursday as a result. If he's unable to play, look for Mason Taylor to again serve as New York's top tight end in his absence.
items.title: Kenyon Sadiq (concussion) limited again Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) logged a limited practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: The rookie was able to participate in Thursday's practice in a limited fashion. He is drawing close to a return from the ankle injury that left him on injured reserve, but it's still unclear whether or not his return will come in time for Sunday's divisional matchup against the Patriots.
items.title: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) logs limited practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Joseph Ossai (ankle) missed another practice session on Thursday.
items.impact: Ossai missed another practice session on Thursday due to the ankle injury that he's recovering from. He may very well be sidelined in Week 6, which would leave New York's defensive front weaker than usual ahead of a big divisional matchup against the Patriots.
items.title: Joseph Ossai (ankle) misses another practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Adonai Mitchell (finger) did not take part in New York's practice on Thursday.
items.impact: Mitchell was again a non-participant at practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from a finger injury. He will almost certainly be sidelined again in Week 6, but the potential return of rookie 	Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) could help to offset the effects of Mitchell's likely absence.
items.title: Adonai Mitchell (finger) doesn't practice Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Breece Hall (quad) was officially a non-participant at practice again on Thursday.
items.impact: Hall was seen working with trainers off to the side at practice on Thursday, but he wasn't able to take part in any official drills and ended up being a non-participant. Fantasy managers should expect him to be sidelined for at least one more game, which will lead to more work for Braelon Allen against the Patriots.
items.title: Breece Hall (quad) officially a non-participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: New England's star cornerback seems likely to play in Week 6. He was upgraded to a full participant on Thursday after being limited by a shoulder issue on Wednesday, and he told reporters earlier in the week that he will be good to play. New England's defense will greatly benefit from the likely return of their star cornerback in a divisional matchup against the Jets this week.
items.title: Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) upgraded to full participant Thursday

items.author: Leo Sells
items.desc: Carlton Davis III (neck) was a non-participant at practice on Thursday.
items.impact: The veteran cornerback wasn't able to practice again on Thursday, as he is still dealing with a neck injury that left him sidelined last week. He seems likely to be sidelined again in Week 6, but we won't know for sure for at least another day.
items.title: Carlton Davis III (neck) a non-participant Thursday
